CDbgEapStatus

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x3188
Size:
0x8
Source:
dfd.rdl

Description

Register to indicate if EAP Pair was activated. Use the corresponding w2c register to reset the status. There are 2 bits for each EAP. The bit corresponds to action-0 and action-1 of the EAP. The register is used by SW to know if an action was taken (ex: NMI ISR needs to know which of the EAP triggered the NMI)
